is_base: required; true on exactly one row per product reference
category: required; one of the codes on the Categories sheet

food.ingredients: required by CH-WEB, CH-MKT-A, CH-MKT-B, CH-PRINT; order is part of the value; do not sort; applies to baby.feeding.formula, baby.feeding.weaning only; one entry per cell, separated by '|'
